Name: Unlockable Bundles
Author: DeLiXxN
Description:
[font=Verdana][size=4][b]For Players
[/b][/size]- - - - - - - - - - -

[size=3]Setup[/size][/font][list=1]
[*][font=Verdana]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/font]
[*][font=Verdana]Unpack Unlockable Bundles in your Mods Folder[/font]
[*][font=Verdana]Unpack your content pack in your Mods Folder[/font]
[*][font=Verdana]Make sure you've installed all requirements of the content pack[/font]
[*][font=Verdana]Start the game using the SMAPI Launcher[/font]
[/list][font=Verdana]
[/font][font=Verdana][size=3]Multiplayer[/size]

All Players need to have both Unlockable Bundles and matching content packs installed.
Mismatching versions will cause issues. It is recommended to keep your mods updated to the latest version.

[color=#6aa84f][size=5]✔[/size][/color] [size=4]Multiplayer[/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=5]✔[/size][/color] [size=4]Gamepad[/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=5]✔[/size][/color] [size=4]Clean Savefiles[/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=5]✔[/size][/color][size=4] Android Support[/size]

[size=4][b]For Content Creators
[/b][/size]- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

Create your own Unlockable Bundles content pack for your project within minutes and benefit from a variety of bundle types and customizability. Not quite sure what to do with it yet? No problem! Just snoop through the Demo provided in the downloads section at your own pace.

Please refer to the gitlab wiki for documentation:
[url=https://gitlab.com/delixx/stardew-valley/unlockable-bundles/-/wikis/home]https://gitlab.com/delixx/stardew-valley/unlockable-bundles/-/wikis/home
[/url]﻿
How does it work?
Just add "DLX.Bundles" in your manifest dependencies and append the UnlockableBundles/Bundles asset.
Here's how that could look using content patcher

[/font]{

{
[color=#ffe599]"Action"[/color]: [color=#ffd966]"EditData"[/color],
[color=#ffe599]"Target"[/color]: [color=#ffd966]"UnlockableBundles/Bundles"[/color],
[color=#ffe599]"Entries"[/color]: {

﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿  [color=#ffe599]"ShopType":[color=#ffd966] "Dialogue"[/color][/color][color=#ffe599],[/color] [color=#b6d7a8]//The bundle type [/color]
  [color=#ffe599]"Location"[/color]: [color=#ffd966]"Farm"[/color], [color=#b6d7a8]//You can use the [i]ub location[/i] command in the smapi console to get the current location name[/color]

  [color=#ffe599]"ShopPosition"[/color]: [color=#ffd966]"18, 8"[/color], [color=#b6d7a8]//The coordinates of the bundle shop the player interacts with[/color]
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿  [color=#ffe599]"ShopTexture":[/color][color=#ffd966]"[color=#ffd966]{{InternalAssetKey: [color=#ffd966][color=#ffd966]assets/BridgeChunk.png[/color][/color]}}[/color]",[/color][color=#b6d7a8] //A game asset containing the bundles shop texture[/color]
